auditNote: Every check below is computed from app/data/trophies.json at load time, so the numbers always match the shipped guide.

disagreements.claim: How long does the platinum take?
disagreements.howWeHandleIt: Plan for 200 hours and budget 250. The 200-hour figure is the roadmap's headline; the 250+ figure is shown wherever the time is quoted.

disagreements.claim: How many stunts does the trophy need?
disagreements.howWeHandleIt: Do 250 for the trophy, then 300 for the 100% checklist. The two numbers answer different questions, so both are shown.

sourceA.name: PowerPyx
sourceA.says: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts for the trophy; the 100% checklist needs 300.

disagreements.claim: How long is the final cleanup step?
disagreements.howWeHandleIt: Budget 10 to 20 hours for Step 3. The roadmap shows the range, not a single number.

sourceA.name: PowerPyx
sourceA.says: Step 3, Strangers and Freaks plus miscellaneous cleanup, takes about 10 hours.

disagreements.claim: Is the Chapter 1 meditation required for Positive Mental Attitude?
disagreements.howWeHandleIt: Do it anyway and keep a manual save from Chapter 1. Both sources agree it is unconfirmed; they differ only on what to do about it.

sourceA.name: PowerPyx
sourceA.says: It is currently unclear whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy.

sourceB.name: KeenGamer
sourceB.says: Complete it anyway to avoid unnecessary risk; whether it is required remains unconfirmed.

disagreements.claim: How does the unconfirmed hidden trophy (id 49) unlock?
disagreements.howWeHandleIt: No method is shown, because none is confirmed. The only published lead is labelled as a belief, and the guide says so in plain words.

sourceA.name: PowerPyx
sourceA.says: Currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again in Little Cuba.

sourceB.name: KeenGamer
sourceB.says: Hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method; do not rely on unverified methods.

disagreements.claim: How many vehicles are in the game?
disagreements.howWeHandleIt: Both numbers are kept, with what each counts. The 557 counts every vehicle at launch; the 277 counts base models only, and only those count toward the 100% checklist.

sourceA.name: PowerPyx
sourceA.says: GTA VI features 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).

sourceB.name: PowerPyx
sourceB.says: For the 100% checklist you need to scan any 200 of the 277 base model vehicles.

counts.stunts: 250 for the trophy, 300 for 100%, 397 in total

facts.saves: 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave; keep a save at the start and end of each chapter.
facts.timeToPlatinum: About 200 hours (PowerPyx); Push Square says 250+ hours

roadmap.note: Progress made during the story already counts toward the 100% checklist, even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story.
roadmap.title: Finish the story, do optional missions as they appear
what: Play all 5 chapters, about 60 to 80 hours.
Take optional missions as they appear; you need 100 for the checklist and there are far more than that.
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you travel.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends.

roadmap.note: The checklist is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed and collectibles are only partly required.
roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist and 70 of 80 challenges
what: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story.
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges, skipping the hardest ten.
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest; those are required in full.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, complete 300 stunts.

roadmap.note: Every trophy-related quest giver returns after the story, so nothing in this step can be missed.
roadmap.title: Strangers and Freaks plus miscellaneous cleanup
what: Finish the 8 Strangers and Freaks strands that count toward the trophy.
Finish the side-character final missions: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Sweep up whatever is left: activities, collectibles, robberies and the unconfirmed trophy if a method is published.
